log: Built processes.js (poller + RAM/CPU graph with shared hover crosshair + by-task rows with sparklines + orphans + worktrees), wired into live.js (Processes section, Running-now pid/MB badges), ai2-proc-* CSS. Headless proof caught two real bugs, both in my own ai2.css and both fixed: (1) `.ai2-proc-pids` set `display:flex` on a direct child of a closed `<details>` — an author `display` always beats the browser's own collapse rule, so every group row rendered its full pid list even closed (measured 14,000px tall). (2) reusing `.ai2-live-item`'s look on the `<details>` row also inherited its 4-column grid, which squeezed `<summary>` into an 88px sliver and word-wrapped the group name one letter per line. Fixed with an explicit collapse rule and `grid-column:1/-1` on every row child. By-task list now shows the top 5 groups open, the rest behind one '18 more' fold, per task-mastermind-dormant-idle's steer to keep the section short by default.
